summary: Commit 1b8bfd183 turns on Metro inline requires through getTransformOptions (experimentalImportSupport and inlineRequires both true; React and React Native are in nonInlinedRequires). An @ryco/* ESM resolver shim keeps the bundle's module set the same. The import-time configurators stay eager through bare imports in index.ts. The commit message gives release-build measurements: 2,331 -> 1,257 modules evaluated by splash hide, and 283 -> 255 ms median from bundle start to splash hide. I looked for other side effects at module scope in apps/mobile/src. App.tsx has two (preventAutoHideAsync and applyResolvedAppColorScheme), and they run when App is evaluated, which index.ts forces right away through registerRootComponent. hostedHub/runtime.ts registers the trust source and the primary connection factory at module scope. Since #710, which landed before 1b8bfd183, that module has been loaded lazily on purpose, and both of its consumers handle a missing registration: primaryConnectionFactory returns null, and useAuthoritativeNodeTrust handles a null source with a subscription. Deferring them further therefore changes nothing. Barrel re-exports (export *) still evaluate eagerly, as the original verifier noted. That limits how much more inlining can save, but it is not a gap in the fix. Nothing has changed metro.config.js or index.ts since the commit.

evidence.note: NON_INLINED_REQUIRES (React, react/jsx-runtime, react-compiler-runtime, react-native) plus the getTransformOptions override: inlineRequires true, experimentalImportSupport true.
@ryco/* specifiers are resolved with isESMImport:true so the import-only export conditions still match when requires are inlined.
Bare imports of polyfills, threadsRuntime and hostedHub/state come before App, so those registrations stay eager.
Module-scope splash and color-scheme calls run when App is evaluated, which registerRootComponent triggers immediately. Unaffected.
Module-scope configureAuthoritativeNodeTrustSource and installHostedPrimaryConnectionFactory. runtime.ts is already lazy by design (#710), and its consumers tolerate the registrations being absent.
Returns null until the hosted runtime loads, which matches the documented pre-load behaviour.
Handles a null trust source and subscribes for late registration.
Tests pin the inline-requires options, the ESM resolution of @ryco/* packages, and the order of the bare imports in index.ts.
